2121630917621887017.en_summary: Most stocks do not go up in a straight line. They go up, they fall apart, and then they go up again — and the fall is where the money is made, if the story is still true. $PLTR went to $45 in early 2021. Then it fell to $7-8, and the bottom printed near $6. More than an 80% drawdown. Everyone wrote it off. The business kept building.
2121630917621887017.zh_summary: 大多數股票不會直線上漲。它們上漲、崩跌，然後再次上漲——如果故事仍然真實，下跌就是賺錢的地方。$PLTR在2021年初漲到45美元。然後跌到7-8美元，底部接近6美元。超過80%的回撤。所有人都放棄了它。業務卻持續建設。
